canonicalName: Classification theory in model theory (Morley, Shelah)

milestones.label: Morley's categoricity theorem
milestones.work: M. Morley, Categoricity in power, Trans. AMS (1965)
milestones.description: Morley proves that a countable first-order theory categorical in one uncountable cardinal is categorical in all, opening the classification of theories by their models.

evidence.claim: Crossref record: 'Categoricity in power', Trans. AMS, 1965
Wikipedia dates Morley's theorem to 1965 and cites this paper

milestones.note: Abstract itself not opened; theorem content from Wikipedia.

milestones.label: Shelah on the number of models of unstable theories
milestones.work: S. Shelah, The number of non-isomorphic models of an unstable first-order theory, Israel J. Math. (1971)
milestones.description: Shelah's paper links instability of a theory to many non-isomorphic models, an early step of the stability dividing line.

evidence.claim: Crossref record gives title, author, Israel J. Math., Feb 1971

milestones.note: Only metadata checked; role inferred from title.

milestones.label: Shelah's Classification Theory book
milestones.work: S. Shelah, Classification Theory and the Number of Non-Isomorphic Models (North-Holland, 1978)
milestones.description: Systematic monograph on stability theory and the classification programme.

evidence.claim: Reference list gives first publication 1978, 2nd edition 1990
Crossref: review of the revised edition (1990) of this book
